about.seo_title: About — Rostyslav Borovyk, AI automation specialist
about.seo_description: Rostyslav Borovyk: AI automation with Make.com, Supabase and OpenAI. AI LAB graduate, author of AutoHunter. Freelance and open to full-time roles.
about.title: Hi, I'm Rostyslav
about.lead: An AI automation specialist from Ukraine. I build systems that take routine work off businesses and design them to cost as little as possible to run.
approach: I completed the AI Specialist course at AI LAB. My graduation project is AutoHunter: an AI bot that monitors AUTO.RIA and finds cars priced below market.
My rule is simple: heavy logic goes into the database, and AI is called only where it's really needed. That's how AutoHunter's Make usage dropped from 158 to 39 credits per run.
I work with clients as a freelancer and I'm open to a full-time role in a team building AI products.
